zh: 避免某事；使不卷入某事；使置身于…之外；使不受…的影响
en: to avoid something; to prevent somebody from being involved in something or affected by something
ex: That child can't keep out of mischief.
那孩子总是胡闹。

zh: 不偏离（或不离开）道路等
不偏离主题；不跑题
遵守（或信守、履行）诺言
坚守，不离开（某地或某个位置）
en: to avoid leaving a path, road, etc.
ex: Keep to the track—the land is very boggy around here.
顺着道儿走，这一带到处是沼泽地。

zh: 离群索居；不与人往来；不管别人的事
对…秘而不宣（或保守秘密）；不将…说出去
en: to avoid meeting people socially or becoming involved in their affairs
ex: Nobody knows much about him; he keeps himself very much to himself.
谁对他都不太了解，因为他很少和人交往。

zh: 控制，压制（人）
en: to control or oppress somebody
ex: The local people are kept under by the army.
当地居民受军队管制。

zh: （天气）持续不变
（与…）齐步前进，并驾齐驱；跟上
使某人熬夜（或开夜车、不睡觉）
使某事物保持在高水平
en: if particular weather keeps up, it continues without stopping
ex: The rain kept up all afternoon.
雨下了整整一个下午。

zh: 与（某人）保持联系
熟悉，了解（消息、形势等）
继续支付；继续做
en: to continue to be in contact with somebody
ex: How many of your old school friends do you keep up with?
你与多少老同学保持着联系？

zh: 忍住（或克制自己）不做某事
en: to prevent yourself from doing something
ex: She could hardly keep from laughing.
她差一点儿笑了出来。

zh: （集体）健身锻炼，健身操
en: physical exercises that you do, usually in a class with other people, in order to improve your strength and to stay healthy
ex: a keep-fit class
健身班

zh: 看守人；保管人
（尤指动物园的）饲养员
goalkeeper (= in football (soccer), hockey, etc., a player whose job is to stop the ball from going into his or her own team’s goal)
wicketkeeper (= in cricket, a player who stands behind the wicket in order to stop or catch the ball)
en: a person whose job is to take care of a building, its contents or something valuable
ex: the keeper of geology at the museum
博物馆地质资料的保管人

zh: 纪念品
en: a small object that somebody gives you so that you will remember them
ex: My aunt gave me one of her brooches as a keepsake.
我的姑母把她的一只胸针送给我作纪念。

zh: （阿拉伯男子戴的）方头巾
en: a square of cloth worn on the head by some Arab men and fastened by a band

zh: （尤指盛啤酒的）小桶
（英国，用气压出的）桶装啤酒
en: a round wooden or metal container with a flat top and bottom, used especially for storing beer, like a barrel but smaller
ex: Most of our beer is packaged in 50 litre aluminium kegs.
我们的大多数啤酒都是用50升铝桶包装的。

zh: （英国，用气压出的）桶装啤酒
en: (in the UK) beer served from metal containers, using gas pressure

zh: a party at which beer is served from kegs
en: a party at which beer is served from kegs
ex: I didn't really want to go to the Friday night kegger.
我真的不想去星期五晚上的小桶。

zh: (1856-1915) a Scottish miner who became a politician. He started the Scottish Parliamentary Labour Party in 1888, and the Independent Labour Party in 1893, and then played a major part in creating the British Labour Party, which he led from 1906 to 1908. He was proud of his working-class origins, and became known as 'the member for the unemployed'.
en: (1856-1915) a Scottish miner who became a politician. He started the Scottish Parliamentary Labour Party in 1888, and the Independent Labour Party in 1893, and then played a major part in creating the British Labour Party, which he led from 1906 to 1908. He was proud of his working-class origins, and became known as 'the member for the unemployed'.

zh: 自行车凯林赛（参赛者先是跟在一辆小型摩托车后在室内赛道上完成一定圈数，然后彼此竞速争取最先通过终点）
en: a racing event in which people cycle a number of times around an indoor track, initially following a small bicycle with a motor and then competing against each other to complete the race

zh: 屁股
en: the part of the body that you sit on
ex: I’m not going to freeze my keister off out there.
我不会把我的凯斯特冻掉的

zh: a first name for boys
en: a first name for boys

zh: a form of Chinese spoken by a group of people in south-east China
en: a form of Chinese spoken by a group of people in south-east China

zh: （土耳其）基里姆地毯
en: a type of Turkish carpet or rug

zh: a large US company (the Kellogg Company) that sells its many breakfast cereals (= grains processed as food) around the world. They include Kellogg's Corn Flakes, Rice Krispies, Special K and Crunchy Nut. Other Kellogg's products include Pop-Tarts and, in the US, Eggo. The company was started in 1906 by Will Keith Kellogg (1860-1951) in Battle Creek, Michigan.
en: a large US company (the Kellogg Company) that sells its many breakfast cereals (= grains processed as food) around the world. They include Kellogg's Corn Flakes, Rice Krispies, Special K and Crunchy Nut. Other Kellogg's products include Pop-Tarts and, in the US, Eggo. The company was started in 1906 by Will Keith Kellogg (1860-1951) in Battle Creek, Michigan.

zh: 基洛纳（加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省的城市）
en: a city in the Canadian province of British Columbia

zh: 海带；巨型海藻
en: a type of brown seaweed, sometimes used as a fertilizer to help plants grow

zh: 水妖
（澳大利亚）卡尔比犬
en: a water spirit, especially one that takes the form of a horse

zh: 开（开尔文温标的计量单位，1 开相当于 1 摄氏度，但以绝对零度为计算起点，水的冰点为 273.15 开）
en: a unit for measuring temperature. One kelvin is equal in size to one degree Celsius, but the Kelvin scale starts at absolute zero and water freezes at 273.15 kelvin.

zh: (1931-2018) an English comedian and singer from Liverpool with untidy hair and big teeth that stuck out. His type of comedy continued many of the old traditions of the music hall.
en: (1931-2018) an English comedian and singer from Liverpool with untidy hair and big teeth that stuck out. His type of comedy continued many of the old traditions of the music hall.

zh: (1927-2011) an English film director. He began his career producing films for television about the lives of poets and composers, but was best known for his cinema films. These included Women in Love (1969), The Music Lovers (1971), Mahler (1974) and Tommy (1975). He also made a television version of Lady Chatterley's Lover (1993). Some people criticized his films for including too much sex and violence, but others admired his lively and imaginative style.
en: (1927-2011) an English film director. He began his career producing films for television about the lives of poets and composers, but was best known for his cinema films. These included Women in Love (1969), The Music Lovers (1971), Mahler (1974) and Tommy (1975). He also made a television version of Lady Chatterley's Lover (1993). Some people criticized his films for including too much sex and violence, but others admired his lively and imaginative style.

zh: a sweet flavoured with mint and sold in hard, flat bars. It is traditional to eat it when walking or climbing in the countryside. It is made in Kendal, Cumbria.
en: a sweet flavoured with mint and sold in hard, flat bars. It is traditional to eat it when walking or climbing in the countryside. It is made in Kendal, Cumbria.

zh: 剑道（日本剑术，用轻木质剑）
en: a Japanese form of the sport of fencing, using light wooden weapons

zh: a castle near Coventry, England. It was owned by several kings, and the Earl of Leicester entertained Elizabeth I there in 1575. Parts of the castle were pulled down by Oliver Cromwell's soldiers to sell as building materials.
en: a castle near Coventry, England. It was owned by several kings, and the Earl of Leicester entertained Elizabeth I there in 1575. Parts of the castle were pulled down by Oliver Cromwell's soldiers to sell as building materials.

zh: a US product name for a range of popular household electrical goods, including refrigerators and washing machines
en: a US product name for a range of popular household electrical goods, including refrigerators and washing machines

zh: JFK
en: JFK

zh: 狗窝；犬舍
（寄养狗的）养狗场；狗繁殖场
en: a small shelter for a dog to sleep in
ex: We put the dog in kennels when we go away.
我们外出时把狗寄养在养狗场。
